about_the_game:
【Ultimate cute clicker game♥】

"Kawaii Clicker" is a clicker game where you produce hearts with cute characters.

Let's click the girls.

Clicking will increase the gauge and enter "Fever Mode", which has a production bonus effect.

Use the hearts you collect to purchase mysterious items and produce even more hearts!

Sex scenes are LIVE 2D Animation!

What? Why collect hearts...?

That's to watch the cute character animations!

Let's fill the world with kawaii♥!

【Fever Mode】

Normal Fever: Powerful bonuses to heart production and click production!

Ultra Fever: Super powerful production bonus!

Click Fever: Bonus to production with repeated clicks!

Gatling Fever: Bonus to item production every 6 clicks!

Monster Fever: Defeat monsters! Attack with repeated clicks!

Spin Fever: Spin the magic circle! Earn tons of hearts with each spin!

Slot Fever: Match 3 slot numbers to earn tons of hearts!

【Mini-games】

Farm: Use hearts to grow and harvest crops. Crops will increase your production while they are growing!

Bingo: Draw numbers to get bingo! A chance to get lots of hearts!

Rebirth: A strong new game! Increase your production and click more efficiently!

【Appealing points】

  • A mix of traditional clicker game style and cute character animations.

  • Purchasing upgrades will dramatically increase your heart production.

  • A chance to get lots of hearts in "Fever Mode"!

  • Get even more hearts in "Ultra Fever Mode"!
